PHYSICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

20. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
